_doc: Monsieur's rules for environmental events (V3, 2026-10-04). Deterministic, applied after the decision model. Edit freely; threads are Beeper chat ids or Gmail thread ids, people are display names as they appear.
_silent_group_networks: Groups on these networks are ignored without calling the model while Monsieur has not written there in 30 days and is not mentioned (2026-11-05). Muted threads are also settled without the model.
groups: notify only when Monsieur is mentioned or the message is urgent
